summary.text: Cherie Johnson is the Republican candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 26 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Jack Hedin.
On her campaign website she describes herself as an educator, foster parent and community leader from Winona.

paragraphs.text: Johnson says on her campaign website that she and her husband, Ben, raised their children in Winona and that she has worked as a teacher and coach.
She says she mentors youth through her church, volunteers with local organizations, has served on community boards and is a foster parent.
She lists affordability and responsible spending, small business, farms, education and support for veterans and law enforcement among her priorities.
